package endorsement

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"
 "time"
)

func TestAuditJSSigstoreBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
 directory:=os.Getenv("TINFOIL_JS_SIGSTORE_FIXTURES")
 raw,e:=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory,"provenance-boundaries.json"));if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 var provenance struct{ Repo string; Digest string; Cases []struct{Name string; Bundle json.RawMessage; Root json.RawMessage; Accepted bool} }
 if e=json.Unmarshal(raw,&provenance);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 for _,c:=range provenance.Cases {t.Run(c.Name,func(t *testing.T){
  client,e:=NewClientFromJSON(c.Root);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
  _,e=client.AuthenticateCode(c.Bundle,Reference{Repo:provenance.Repo,Tag:"v1.0.0"},"v1.0.0",provenance.Digest)
  if (e==nil)!=c.Accepted {t.Fatalf("expected acceptance %v, got %v",c.Accepted,e)}
 })}
 raw,e=os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(directory,"two-observers.json"));if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 var observers struct{Bundle map[string]any; Root map[string]any; Digest string; Repo string; First int64}
 if e=json.Unmarshal(raw,&observers);e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)}
 check:=func(want bool){t.Helper();rootBytes,_:=json.Marshal(observers.Root);client,e:=NewClientFromJSON(rootBytes);if e!=nil {t.Fatal(e)};bundle,_:=json.Marshal(observers.Bundle);_,e=client.verifyBundle(bundle,observers.Repo,observers.Digest);if (e==nil)!=want {t.Fatalf("expected acceptance %v, got %v",want,e)}}
 check(true)
 observers.Root["certificateAuthorities"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["validFor"].(map[string]any)["end"]=time.Unix(observers.First,0).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
 check(false)
 material:=observers.Bundle["verificationMaterial"].(map[string]any)
 material["tlogEntries"]=material["tlogEntries"].([]any)[:1]
 check(true)
}
